label: Bible Study
prompt: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a _____ at her.
verse: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
note: Jesus' answer to the accusers — and one by one, from the eldest on down, they all walked away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall _____; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verse: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
note: Luke puts this right after a parable about a friend knocking at midnight for bread — persistence pays.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four _____ out of the stern, and wished for the day.
verse: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
note: On Paul's shipwreck voyage the sailors dropped four anchors from the stern and 'wished for the day.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this _____ among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verse: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
note: A mystery in Paul isn't a puzzle but a secret now told: Christ living in Gentile believers.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now unto him that is able to do _____ abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verse: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
note: The doxology that outruns imagination: 'exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think.'
